verdict.rationale: Kimi documents an official desktop app, Kimi Code Desktop, where an agent works on a local project folder. However, nothing in the evidence mentions OS-level hotkeys or seeing what is on the user's screen, so only one element of the story is covered, and only thinly. Missing for 10: OS-level/global keyboard shortcuts, screen-content access or screen capture, general-purpose (non-coding) desktop assistant evidence, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can use an official desktop app with OS-level shortcuts and access to what is on my screen

citations.quote: Open a local project folder in Kimi Code Desktop and let the Agent read code, edit files, run commands, and verify results through conversation.
